# Pantheon Roma

> > Official visitor portal for the Pantheon (Basilica di Santa Maria ad Martyres) in Rome, offering ticket bookings, audioguides, and guided tours.

Operated by the D'Uva "Turista-Pellegrino" (Tourist-Pilgrim) welcome project, this multilingual site provides comprehensive visitor services for one of Rome's most iconic ancient monuments, including audioguides narrated by Sergio Rubini and Alessandro Haber, virtual tours, and practical visit information.

## Key Topics

- Pantheon Rome
- Santa Maria ad Martyres
- Basilica di Santa Maria ad Martyres
- D'Uva Tourist-Pilgrim Project

- Alessandro Haber
- Ancient Rome monument
- Religious tourism
- Ticket booking
- Audioguide services
- Guided tours
- Virtual 3D tours
- Mons. Daniele Micheletti
- Rome visitor information

## Ticket Booking & Visit Planning

- [Buche Tickets für den Besuch des Pantheon in Rom](https://www.pantheonroma.com/de/besuche-das-pantheon-in-rom): Main ticket booking page for Pantheon Rome visits with tours & audioguide
- [Panthéon Rome | Basilique Sainte Marie ad Martyres](https://www.pantheonroma.com/fr/basilica-di-santa-maria-ad-martyres-pantheon-di-roma): Homepage for Pantheon Rome visits: hours, audioguides & guided tours
- [Horaires et informations utiles pour visiter le Panthéon de Rome](https://www.pantheonroma.com/fr/horaires-et-infos): Opening hours, entry info & practical details for Pantheon visits
- [Contatti, informazioni e prenotazioni Pantheon di Roma](https://www.pantheonroma.com/de/kontakte): Contact info for Santa Maria ad Martyres reception service & bookings

## Audioguides

- [Reserve a audioguia do Panteão com total autonomia](https://www.pantheonroma.com/pt/audioguia): Audioguide booking page narrated by Sergio Rubini for Pantheon visits
- [Prenota l'audioguida del Pantheon e scopri la storia in autonomia.](https://www.pantheonroma.com/it/audioguida): Audioguide booking for independent Pantheon Rome visits with narration
- [Reserva la audioguía del Panteón con total autonomía.](https://www.pantheonroma.com/es/audioguia-del-panteon-de-roma): Official audioguide booking with Sergio Rubini narration for Pantheon

## Guided Tours

- [Geführte Tour auf Italienisch im Pantheon von Rom mit Ticket](https://www.pantheonroma.com/de/gefuhrte-tour-im-pantheon): Italian-language guided tour booking for Pantheon Rome with ticket
- [Visite guidée en italien du Panthéon de Rome avec billet](https://www.pantheonroma.com/fr/visite-guidee-au-pantheon): Italian guided tour booking with ticket for Pantheon Rome

## Virtual & Digital Experiences

- [Virtueller Rundgang durch das Pantheon in Rom: interaktive 3D](https://www.pantheonroma.com/de/virtuall-tour): Interactive 360° virtual tour experience of Pantheon Rome in 3D
- [Tour virtual del Panteón de Roma: exploración interactiva en 3D](https://www.pantheonroma.com/es/virtual-tour-2): Interactive 360° virtual tour of Pantheon Rome with exclusive content
- [Virtual tour del Pantheon di Roma: esplorazione interattiva in 3D](https://www.pantheonroma.com/it/virtual-tour): 360° interactive 3D virtual tour of Pantheon Rome with digital content
- [App Panthéon Rome : histoire, récits et informations utiles](https://www.pantheonroma.com/fr/toutes-les-informations-sur-le-pantheon-dans-lapp-officielle): Official Pantheon Rome app for iOS/Android with history & visitor info
- [App Pantheon: Geschichten und nützliche Informationen](https://www.pantheonroma.com/de/app-pantheon-roma): Official Pantheon Rome app with history, events & multilingual audio

- [Progetto di accoglienza "Turista - Pellegrino" Pantheon di Roma](https://www.pantheonroma.com/it/chi-siamo): About page for Turista Pellegrino pilgrim welcome project by D'Uva
- [Projeto de acolhimento "Turista - Peregrino" Panteão de Roma](https://www.pantheonroma.com/pt/quem-somos): About Turista Peregrino pilgrim welcome service by D'Uva for Pantheon
